summary: Captcha + product tags/default-image/content-delivery testing. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass, including 5 new captcha tests (missing captcha -> 422 on login & register, wrong answer -> 400 + reload, single-use enforcement -> 400 on reuse) and 4 new feature tests (default image when image omitted, tags normalized/deduped & capped at 8, content-type requires delivery_content -> 400, full content product flow: creation->admin approve->public endpoints exclude delivery_content->buyer purchase delivers secret->second purchase works due to unlimited stock). Frontend verified: Login/Register captcha renders question (e.g. '7 + 4 = ?'), refresh button loads new question, wrong answer shows 'Incorrect captcha answer' and reloads captcha, correct answer logs in / registers. Vendor product form shows 'What buyers see' (title/category/price/description/tags-chip-input/5 default thumbnails+upload) and 'What buyers receive' (Unique key per buyer / Same content for all + delivery box textarea) with footer 'No image selected: a default image for the category will be used'. Vendor table shows CONTENT DELIVERY row with ∞ stock, no Keys button. Marketplace card tags render as #EBOOK #PDF. Product detail shows 'Instant · unlimited'. Admin Listing requests Preview dialog shows image, SHOWN TO BUYERS description, #tags chips, 'BUYER RECEIVES · UNIQUE KEY (0 IN STOCK)', private delivery content. Buyer purchase flow: Buy -> Confirm purchase dialog -> Pay from wallet -> 'Purchase delivered' dialog with 'YOUR DIGITAL GOODS' secret value + copy icon + Open vault; toast 'Delivered to your vault' shown. Public GET /api/products and /api/products/{id} confirmed NOT to leak delivery_content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:68 image fallback uses DEFAULT_IMAGES[body.category] - category literal already restricts to the 5 keys so KeyError impossible, good.
verify_captcha deletes captcha even on invalid answer (find_one_and_delete) - correct single-use semantic; captcha TTL index on expires_at cleans stale.
Login attempts lockout uses iso string compare on locked_until and 5-attempt threshold matches auth playbook; no TTL on login_attempts (minor, won't grow much).
test_credentials: admin@market.com/Admin@123, buyer@market.com/Buyer@123, vendor@market.com/Vendor@123 (now require math captcha)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Captcha helper _solve_captcha() in backend_test.py fetches /api/auth/captcha and solves +, -, × ops; used by _login/_register. Frontend captcha data-testids: {mode}-captcha-question, {mode}-captcha-input, {mode}-captcha-refresh where mode is 'login' or 'register'. Vendor product form testids: pf-title-input, pf-category-select, pf-price-input, pf-description-input, pf-tags-input, pf-default-image-0..4, pf-image-input, pf-delivery-keys, pf-delivery-content, pf-delivery-content-input, pf-submit-btn, product-form-dialog. Admin preview testid: listing-preview-<pid>. Purchase flow: click [data-testid=buy-now-btn] opens confirm dialog with [data-testid=confirm-buy-btn] 'Pay from wallet' - two-step confirmation.
rca of the issue: No bugs found - all new captcha + product-tags + default-image + content-delivery flows work correctly end-to-end.
